# plcstream2py

> stream2py interface to PLC data


## Pages in this subsection

- [plcstream2py](plcstream2py.html.md): stream2py interface to Siemens S7 PLC data.
- [plcstream2py.plc](plcstream2py.plc.html.md): A &#96;stream2py&#96; source reader for Siemens S7 PLC data.
- [plcstream2py.raw_plc](plcstream2py.raw_plc.html.md): Thin, snap7-level access to values stored in a Siemens S7 PLC.
- [plcstream2py.snap7_compat](plcstream2py.snap7_compat.html.md): One place that knows how &#96;python-snap7&#96; is laid out, across its major versions.
